competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a whip, decreasing the enemy's Attack Speed for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage increases according to Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: Attacks with a burning whip and inflicts Continuous Damage for 3 turns. The damage also increases as your Attack Speed increases. In addition, the damage increases by 15% per harmful effect.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Elongates the harmful effect on the enemy for 1 turn and decreases the duration of beneficial effect by 1 turn when you attack. Damage is increased by 30% if the enemy's HP is below 50%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Increases the duration of one or more debuffs on the enemy
Reduces the remaining time of an enemy's beneficial effect.
